prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as well as adoption and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, resulting in negative noise-corrected effects and one test stopped early.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -4.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Mascot Stage Layout: Redesign the path selection screen into an interactive stage layout showcasing path options. (why: The choose_path step has a 23.8% drop-off rate with a high mean time of 514s, indicating users need a clearer, more engaging display.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Choice Hint Component: Add a clear hint to the initial story screen explaining the upcoming adoption options. (why: Users take a median of 8s but a mean of 514s on path choice, suggesting early ambiguity about what selection entails.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Clear Account Data Security Copy: Update headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize cloud backup and pet safety. (why: 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, making cloud sync messaging crucial during sign-in.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Compact Sign-In Options Layout: Switch the sign-in screen layout to a compact view highlighting quick sign-in actions. (why: The sign_in step drops off 27.1% of users with an average duration of 567s.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a carousel layout for selecting pets. (why: Adoption shows the highest funnel drop-off at 39.1%, requiring a more visual selection pattern.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Confirmation Screen: Insert a dedicated confirmation screen right after picking a friend to confirm the pet selection. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off (39.1%) and a long mean time (1017s), benefiting from a dedicated confirmation step.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Estimated Ready Time Display: Display an estimated time remaining and notification status on the waiting screen while initialization runs. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty during desktop asset generation.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Rotating Tips: Add auto-rotating tip intervals to the waiting screen while desktop pet setup finishes. (why: Support receives multiple questions post-onboarding regarding desktop controls, which can be taught during the wait.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split View Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a split view layout showing pet welcome graphics and primary control tips. (why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2%, and support mails show confusion on how to control or interact with pets after setup.)
